caption: Select secret IDs without a value display.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['secret-parcel']; p.closeDialogs(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.opts.tokens = { get: () => null, set: () => {}, clear: () => {} }; p.pro.signOut(); const values = { 'openai-key': 'sk-sample-only', 'github-token': 'ghp_sample-only', 'todoist-token': 'sample-only' }; Object.defineProperty(p, 'storage', { configurable: true, value: { listSecrets: () => Object.keys(values), getSecret: id => values[id] ?? null, setSecret: (id, v) => { values[id] = v; } } });p.openExport(); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal-content .secret-parcel-list .setting-item')]; rows.slice(0, 2).forEach(r => r.querySelector('.checkbox-container').click()); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The exported parcel has a path and a safe next step.

caption: Save an ID prefix and a vault folder for reuse.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['secret-parcel']; p.closeDialogs(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.opts.tokens = { get: () => null, set: () => {}, clear: () => {} }; p.pro.signOut(); const values = { 'openai-key': 'sk-sample-only', 'github-token': 'ghp_sample-only', 'todoist-token': 'sample-only' }; Object.defineProperty(p, 'storage', { configurable: true, value: { listSecrets: () => Object.keys(values), getSecret: id => values[id] ?? null, setSecret: (id, v) => { values[id] = v; } } });p.pro.opts.tokens = { get: () => 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36), set: () => {}, clear: () => {} }; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'sample-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); await p.pro.refreshNow();p.prefs.profiles = [{ name: 'Work accounts', prefix: 'work-', folder: 'Secret Parcels/Work' }, { name: 'AI tools', prefix: 'openai-', folder: 'Secret Parcels/AI' }]; p.openProfiles(); return 'ok'; })()
